title: Cute Baby Outdoors in Walker, 1950s Deckled Edge B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A sweet black-and-white outdoor snapshot of an infant sitting upright in a metal-and-wood baby walker or high chair in the backyard next to a clapboard house. The child wears a light-colored cotton shirt and diaper, resting bare feet on the footrest and holding onto a circular toy or teething ring. Shadows from surrounding trees fall across the siding behind them, capturing a candid glimpse into mid-century American domestic babyhood. The print features classic decorative deckled edges.
